purpose: Development and regression subset for task-success improvements with time/token cost tracking

main_stratification.fallback: Document uncovered mechanisms before relaxing quotas; never silently change the selection protocol

selection_priorities: Coverage of evidence-backed failure mechanisms from both first-attempt deployment baseline cohorts
Partial near misses with one failed check, kept separate from zero-of-one tasks
Zero-passed-check failures, separating single-check completion tasks from multi-check failures
Both-model failures and directional model disagreements
Paper difficulties: target assignment, multi-drone coordination, sequential targets, patrol/search completion, photo and progress validation
Both-model successful controls for regression detection
Diversity of templates, endpoints, drone counts, obstacles and task lengths
Lower observed iteration cost among candidates with comparable coverage
execution_authorized_by_this_request: offline analysis, selection and export only; no paid model runs or changes to active full experiments
deliverables: README_CN.md with selection rationale, limitations and replay protocol
Frozen main/development/validation/fast manifests with ordered task IDs
Original selected scene JSON files and checksums
Task and scene CSVs with both-model baselines and evidence links
Observed baseline time/token estimates for each split

selection_basis.change_reason: User requested finalization as the default experiment dataset after the existing two-model deployment accounting report was finalized; retain observed failures separately from infrastructure failures.

eligibility: Within each family/difficulty cell, minimize the number of first-attempt unscored model-task rows before selecting for coverage. All selected scenes have 20 observed checker outcomes for both models.
baseline_update_policy: Historical first-attempt baseline is immutable. Any new baseline or recovered results use separately named reports and never replace selected IDs, task order, checks or this baseline.
